subject: State Audit Request
overview: The council debated and rejected a resolution calling for the Massachusetts State Auditor to examine municipal finances and recent council proceedings. The council also approved several committee reports, a memorial resolution, and a donation for Pride Month activities.

items.title: Condolence resolution for Robin Irving
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences to the family of longtime Medford public school teacher Robin Irving.

items.title: Approval of records
items.summary: Approved the records of the June 25, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Committee reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Planning and Permitting Committee, Committee of the Whole, and Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee covering the council's zoning consultant work plan, governing agenda, and resident guides.

items.title: Resolution requesting State Auditor examination
items.summary: The council failed a resolution requesting that the Office of the State Auditor examine city finances and council procedural actions following a lengthy debate over free cash certification, budget deadlines, and parliamentary rulings.

items.title: Pride Month donation acceptance
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $500 donation from the Boston Foundation Corporation for municipal Pride Month activities.
